mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_run_event (run_id, event_id, sequence_no, event_type, payload_json, occurred_time, create_time) VALUES (#{runId}, #{eventId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{eventType}, #{payloadJson}, #{occurredTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ai_run_event WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND (event_id = #{eventId} OR sequence_no = #{sequenceNo})
